svg.title: Magneticraft2 — Industrial Air Blower K1 Studio reference

g.text: Bronze IV • 3 × 3 × 3 (W × H × D) • editable orthographic concept and actual module positions
FRONT CONCEPT • guarded axial impeller, grounded bearings
SOUTH blueprint • each row rear → front
S = Stone Bricks • P = Oak Planks • A = required AIR
I = Rear Gear V2 input • C = Front controller / actual air outlet
No existing air pipes or direct Bloomery connection in K1.
REAL K1: ≥16 RPM • torque 5 • 1 pressure unit / 5 supplied ticks • 16-unit buffer • 1 unit/tick front-face transfer
Dynamic fan axis: (8,24,-16), Z axis. Rear drive coupling axis: (8,8,-24), Z axis.
Test existing Primitive Furnace bellows module directly adjacent to the formed front controller.
This reference shows modeled visual direction; exact collision, orientation and module positions are defined by JSON.
